events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in Bethel, New York, starting on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock '69
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Woodstock Festival, which kicked off on this day in '69. Three days of peace, love, and music that changed everything.

events.title: Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Forty-nine years today since we lost the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley. Still sounds as good as ever.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, a true icon of the 90s, who we lost on this day in '96. His music continues to resonate.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since the world lost the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix. His guitar work remains absolutely legendary.

events.title: Abbey Road album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969 in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. What's your favourite track from this absolute masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to The Pretenders' frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde. Still rocking as hard as ever!

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Wishing a happy 54th birthday to Oasis and Beady Eye frontman, Liam Gallagher, born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our kid is 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. Wonder what he's got planned for the celebrations.

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple introduced its first-generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember when Apple dropped the original iPod on this day in 2001? Suddenly, a thousand songs in your pocket was a reality. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, which premiered on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! From Sean Connery to Daniel Craig, who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have turned 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy legend, John Cleese, born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy icon.

events.title: 'The White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Classic
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. A double album packed with classics. What's your top track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: The music world remembers Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years today since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His legacy as a performer and vocalist is simply unmatched.

events.title: 'Rubber Soul' album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Classic
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. Often cited as a pivotal moment in their artistic development.
